messages: Create a marketing plan for a new smartphone launch.

title='Smartphone Launch Marketing Plan' steps=['Conduct thorough market research to identify target audience and competitors.', 'Define unique selling propositions (USPs) of the smartphone.', 'Develop branding materials including logo, tagline, and brand message.', 'Create an omnichannel marketing strategy combining digital and traditional media.', 'Design and launch a promotional website highlighting features, specifications, and pre-order options.', 'Engage with influencers and tech reviewers for product reviews and unboxing videos.', 'Set up social media campaigns targeting key demographics on platforms like Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and Twitter.', 'Organize a launch event, either virtual or in-person, and invite media, influencers, and potential buyers.', 'Develop a PR strategy to generate media coverage for the launch event.', 'Launch a paid advertising campaign on Google Ads and social media platforms.', 'Implement email marketing strategies targeting existing and potential customers with pre-launch teasers and launch announcements.', 'Coordinate with retail partners for product placement and promotional in-store displays.', 'Track and analyze marketing efforts using analytics tools to refine strategies and optimize results.'] timeline={'market_research': 'Complete by month 1', 'branding_materials_development': 'Complete in months 1-2', 'website_launch': 'End of month 2', 'initial_social_media_campaigns': 'Start in month 3', 'launch_event': 'Month 4', 'advertising_campaigns': 'Ongoing from month 3', 'email_campaigns': 'Begin in month 2', 'analyze_and_refine': 'Start in month 4 and continue post-launch'}
